newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade at $110/dressed -private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade at $110/dressed -private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold at $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in light volume near midday on Wednesday, market sources said.
The sales were steady with thin trades on Friday but down $1.00 from the bulk of last week's sales, market sources said.
About 1,200 to 2,000 head traded, with further bids at $109.00 to $110.00 passed by owners pricing cattle at $112.00, they said.
Cattle also sold at $67.50 to $68.00 on a live basis, with further bids at the same level passed by owners asking $69.00.
